description: Wire community_signal_enrichment_v2.py into signal_analyser.py so it computes and writes community_signal_enrichment rows to mcp_signal_enrichments. Must use compute_score(metadata) signature, write via write_service :8772, read metadata fields (stars, community_size, download_count, registry_source). Community_signal has 34 distinct values — ensure wiring does not degrade this. Add to signal_analyser polling loop for MCPs missing community_signal_enrichment.
